mostWorthwhile.text: The matched-wood comparison was most worthwhile: the untouched piece made the effect of rubbing clear and showed warmth without visible glow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the printed instructions was less engaging as an action, though their details made the reproduction meaningful.

continue.text: I would continue: the controlled comparison and the careful limits on reproduction made the educational inquiry interesting, even if the final choices were straightforward.
